title: Golden solution leaves blatant broken cell references and cross-sheet errors unfixed, penalizing thorough audits required by the prompt
evidence:
In problem.py:32, the prompt instructs: "Please audit and fix this file thoroughly. Errors may include but are not limited to: formula logic errors or inconsistencies, hardcoded values that should be formulas, broken cell references, data validation issues, potential calculation errors, inconsistent formatting or naming conventions, best practice violations, and any other issues that could affect accuracy or maintainability." However, the sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1.0, 100% of total score) grades against `gt_08_golden.xlsx`, which only fixes 20 cross-sheet formulas (17 on `Operating Model + DCF`, 2 on `Revenue Build`, 1 on `Comps + WACC`) while leaving several blatant formula and cross-sheet reference bugs in `Operating Model + DCF` unfixed:
1. `'Operating Model + DCF'!C36:H36` (2019–2024 D&A) references `='IS Annual'!C75:H75`, which are empty cells below the `IS Annual` table (evaluating to `0`), whereas historical D&A is in `CFS!E4:J4` (`70.248`, `97.398`, `92.848`, `51.739`, `60.923`, `78.738`).
2. `'Operating Model + DCF'!I36:L36` (Q1–Q4 2025 D&A) references `='IS Quarters'!E69:H69` (Q3 2024–Q2 2025, sum `33.2`) instead of `='IS Quarters'!G69:J69` (Q1–Q4 2025, sum `36.9`).
3. `'Operating Model + DCF'!I62:L62` (Q1–Q4 2025 Capex) also references `='IS Quarters'!E69:H69` (2024/2025 Depreciation Expense, sum `33.2`) instead of quarterly Capital Expenditures in `-'Key Stats'!G21:J21` (`6.151`, `9.336`, `14.366`, `14.997`, sum `44.85`), even though `gt_08_golden.xlsx` fixes `C62:H62` in the very same row to reference `-'Key Stats'!C46:H46`.
4. `'Operating Model + DCF'!R84` (2026 Change in NWC) has the broken typo formula `=R847-M83` (pointing to empty row 847 instead of `=R83-M83`, evaluating to `-29.613` instead of `-113.906`).
5. `'Operating Model + DCF'!C90` (2025 Tax Rate) is `-0.3` (`-30%`) instead of `0.3` (`30%` as in `D90:H90`).
Because `verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells` requires `modification_ratio == 1.0` (100% match on all 211 modification cells) and `regression_ratio >= 0.998`, any agent that fixes `I62:L62` or `R84` alters downstream DCF bridge cells (`C95`, `C100`, `D94`, `D95`, `D100`, `R84`) in the modification bucket and automatically receives `score=0.0`.
confirmation: Verified in the golden: C36 links empty 'IS Annual'!C75, I36/I62 link 'IS Quarters'!E69, R84 is '=R847-M83', and C90 is -0.3 while D90 is 0.3; all are unchanged from the input, so fixing them breaks the 100% modification match.
fix: files/gt/gt_08_golden.xlsx, 'Operating Model + DCF': besides R84 '=R847-M83' -> '=R83-M83' and C90 -0.3 -> 0.3, the key now also fixes C36:H36 D&A (pointed at empty 'IS Annual'!C75:H75) -> ='CFS'!E4..J4 (FY2019-FY2024 D&A, 70.248 ... 78.738), I36:L36 FY2025 quarterly D&A (two quarters early, 'IS Quarters'!E69:H69) -> ='IS Quarters'!G69..J69 (Q1-Q4 2025, matching the revenue link in row 4), and I62:L62 FY2025 quarterly capex (pointed at 'IS Quarters' depreciation) -> =-'Key Stats'!G21..J21 (quarterly capital expenditures, sum 44.85 = Key Stats I46). Dependent cached values recomputed with the verifier's LibreOffice recalc and written at XML level (48 cells, e.g. C92 33.2 -> 36.9, C93 33.2 -> 44.85, C116 277.17 -> 277.15). No other cell, formula or style changed.

title: Answer key retains a broken working-capital reference and penalizes its correction
evidence: The task asks to 'audit and fix this file thoroughly,' including broken references and formula logic errors. However, both the input and golden workbook retain 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 =R847-M83. R847 is empty; the formula should reference R83, consistent with the adjacent change-in-working-capital calculations. In the golden workbook, R83 is -84.2928522758825 and M83 is 29.613, so the change should be -113.9058522758825, not the expected -29.613. Correcting only this reference in the golden workbook and recalculating produces four modification-check failures, including R84, D94, D95 and D100 (modification ratio 0.9810). The sole verifier, weighted 1, consequently awards zero despite this valid repair.
confirmation: Input and golden both have R84 '=R847-M83'; golden R83 = -84.293 and M83 = 29.613, so the correct change is -113.906 vs the expected -29.613, and that repair cascades into DCF modification cells, zeroing the score.
fix: files/gt/gt_08_golden.xlsx: 'Operating Model + DCF'!R84 '=R847-M83' -> '=R83-M83' and C90 -0.3 -> 0.3 (unchanged from the earlier fix); dependents recomputed.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check falsely fails all 3 units (score=0.0) for fixing genuine broken formulas left unfixed in gt_08_golden.xlsx
evidence:
Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight: 1) returned `score=0` (`unit 1: regression 0.9979, modification 0.9621, 35 cell error(s)`; `unit 2: regression 0.9917, modification 0.8626, 138 cell error(s)`; `unit 3: regression 0.9900, modification 0.8720, 158 cell error(s)`). Independent trajectory inspection shows that all 3 units correctly identified and fixed all 20 cross-sheet reference bugs that `gt_08_golden.xlsx` fixes (`Operating Model + DCF!E4:G4`, `C7:H7`, `C62:H62`, `M71`, `M77`; `Revenue Build!H17`, `M17`; `Comps + WACC!C34`). In addition, following the prompt's instruction to "audit and fix this file thoroughly", all 3 units fixed genuine bugs that `gt_08_golden.xlsx` mistakenly left broken:
- In unit 1 (steps [59]-[74]), the agent fixed only the 20 golden cells plus three unambiguous errors in `Operating Model + DCF`: (1) `C36:H36` D&A pointing to empty cells `'IS Annual'!C75:H75` (`answer=0`) -> fixed to `=CFS!E4:J4` (`output=70.248`, etc.) and added `C37:H37` `% of revenue`; (2) `I62:L62` 2025 Capex pointing to `'IS Quarters'!E69:H69` (2024 Depreciation, sum `33.2`) -> fixed to `=-'Key Stats'!G21:J21` (2025 Capex, sum `44.85`, cascading to `C93=44.85`, `C95=-235.9136`, `C100=-215.1319`); and (3) `R84` typo `=R847-M83` (`answer=-29.613`) -> fixed to `=R83-M83` (`output=-113.9059`, cascading to `D94`, `D95`, `D100`, `C102=2785.2013`). Those three legitimate fixes account for all 35 cell errors in unit 1.
- In unit 2 (steps [61]-[97]) and unit 3 (steps [63]-[86]), the agents fixed those same bugs plus `I36:L36` (2025 D&A shifted by 2 columns on `IS Quarters`, changing `C92` from `33.2` to `36.9`) and `C90` (2025 tax rate `-0.3` -> `0.3`, changing `C91` from `-169.5096` to `-91.2744`).
Because the verifier requires 100% agreement on modification cells (`mod_ratio == 1.0`) against the flawed `gt_08_golden.xlsx`, it produces false-negative 0.0 verdicts on all 3 high-quality runs.
